setupDescription: Set a passphrase to encrypt your passwords end-to-end.
passphraseMinLength: Passphrase must be at least 10 characters.
setupWarning: If you forget your passphrase, your saved passwords cannot be recovered. Please store it in a safe place.
unlockInterrupted: Unlocking was interrupted before it finished. Please try again.
accountLocked: Account temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts.
accountLockedWithTime: Account temporarily locked. Try again in {time}.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
retryLater: Temporary server error. Please try again.
changePassphraseDescription: Update your vault passphrase. Your saved data will not be affected.
changePassphraseOutcomeUnknown: We couldn't confirm whether your passphrase was changed, so your vault has been locked. Unlock it with your new passphrase. If that doesn't work, use your old one.
changePassphraseNotStartedVaultLocked: Your vault was locked, so your passphrase was not changed. Unlock your vault and try again.
changePassphraseCommittedVaultLocked: Your passphrase was changed, but your vault was locked before the change finished. Unlock it with your new passphrase.
verifierNotSetHint: Lock your vault, then unlock it once with your passphrase (not a passkey) before changing your passphrase.
sessionExpiredDescription: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
recoveryKeyBannerMessage: Set up a Recovery Key to protect against passphrase loss.
recoveryKeyBannerMessageInvalidated: Your previous Recovery Key was invalidated by a recent vault key rotation. Regenerate one now to restore protection against passphrase loss.
recoveryKeyDialogDescription: Generate a Recovery Key to recover your vault if you forget your passphrase.
recoveryKeyEnterPassphrase: Enter your current passphrase to generate a Recovery Key.
recoveryKeyGenerated: Your Recovery Key has been generated.
recoveryKeySavedConfirm: I have saved my Recovery Key in a safe place
recoveryKeyWarning: Store this Recovery Key in a safe place. You will need it to recover your vault if you forget your passphrase. This key will not be shown again.
recoveryKeyRegenerateWarning: You already have a Recovery Key. Generating a new one will invalidate the previous key.
recoveryKeyOutcomeUnknown: We couldn't confirm whether your new Recovery Key was saved. Your previous Recovery Key may no longer work. Generate a new Recovery Key now and store it in a safe place.
recoveryKeyOutcomeUnknownFirstKey: We couldn't confirm whether your new Recovery Key was saved. Generate a new Recovery Key now and store it in a safe place.
recoveryKeyNotStartedVaultLocked: Your vault was locked, so no new Recovery Key was created. Unlock your vault and try again.
recoveryKeyCommittedVaultLocked: A new Recovery Key was created, but your vault was locked before it could be shown. Your previous Recovery Key no longer works. Unlock your vault and generate a new Recovery Key.
recoveryKeyCommittedVaultLockedFirstKey: A new Recovery Key was created, but your vault was locked before it could be shown. Unlock your vault and generate a new Recovery Key.
recoveryKeyRegenerateInvalidatedWarning: Your previous Recovery Key was already invalidated by a vault key rotation. Generate a new Recovery Key below.
setupInviteContext: To accept this invitation, you need to set up your vault first. Please set a passphrase below.
rotateKeyDescription: Generate a new secret key and re-encrypt all vault entries. This invalidates all emergency access grants.
rotateKeyOutcomeUnknown: We couldn't confirm whether your encryption key was rotated, so your vault has been locked. Unlock it with your passphrase, then try the rotation again if it is still needed.
rotateKeyCommittedVaultLocked: Your encryption key was rotated, but your vault was locked before the rotation finished. Unlock it with your passphrase.
rotateKeyNotStartedVaultLocked: Your vault was locked, so the key rotation was not started. Unlock your vault and start the rotation again.
rotateKeyVerifierNotSetHint: Lock your vault, then unlock it once with your passphrase (not a passkey) before rotating your key.
vaultChangedElsewhere: Your vault was changed in another tab or on another device, so it has been locked. Unlock it again, then try again if it is still needed.
rotateKeyWarningEa: All emergency access grants will be invalidated and must be re-confirmed.
rotateKeyWarningTime: This operation may take a while depending on the number of vault entries.
legacyAttachmentHint: Legacy format — will upgrade on next vault rotation
outdatedAttachmentFormat: This attachment cannot be decrypted. Restore from a backup or re-upload the original file.
rotateKeyCacheTombstoneFailureBanner: Some session caches did not invalidate during rotation (Redis outage). Sign out other devices manually and revoke any active sessions from Settings → Sessions.
rotateKeyInvalidationFailedBanner: Token revocation after rotation could not be confirmed. Pre-rotation API keys / MCP tokens may still be live; revoke them manually from Settings.
rotateKeyEffectsUnavailableBanner: Your encryption key was rotated, but the server's report of what else changed could not be read. Your other sessions, API keys and MCP tokens may still be active; review them in Settings and revoke any you do not recognize.
rotateKeyMcpRevokedBanner: {count, plural, one {# pre-rotation MCP token was} other {# pre-rotation MCP tokens were}} revoked. You may need to re-mint at /tenant/service-accounts.
